title.value: COVI-AgentSim: an Agent-based Model for Evaluating Methods of Digital Contact Tracing
title.justification: The title 'COVI-AgentSim: an Agent-based Model for Evaluating Methods of Digital Contact Tracing' clearly indicates the core subject of the research, which is an agent-based model named COVI-AgentSim developed to evaluate digital contact tracing methods.
title.quote: COVI-AgentSim: an Agent-based Model for Evaluating Methods of Digital Contact Tracing

analysis.description: The paper introduces COVI-AgentSim, an agent-based simulation model used to evaluate methods of digital contact tracing, particularly in the context of COVID-19. It aims to provide a testbed for comparing standard binary contact tracing (BCT) with a feature-based method for contact tracing (FCT) that leverages diverse individual features.

type.justification: The study is empirical as it involves the development and empirical validation of a simulation model named COVI-AgentSim, used to test the effectiveness of different digital contact tracing methods. The empirical nature is showcased by comparing simulation outcomes to real-world COVID-19 data and performing sensitivity analyses.
type.quote: We verify by comparing to real data that COVI-AgentSim is able to reproduce realistic COVID-19 spread dynamics, and perform a sensitivity analysis to verify that the relative performance of contact tracing methods are consistent across a range of settings.

name.justification: The primary field is Epidemiology, as the research focuses on modeling and assessing strategies to mitigate the spread of COVID-19, a public health concern, using digital contact tracing techniques.
name.quote: Keywords: Epidemiology, Digital contact tracing, Agent-based model, COVID-19, SARS-CoV-2, Simulation, Intervention evaluation

name.justification: Simulation is a sub-field since the research implements an agent-based model as a simulation tool to study and evaluate digital contact tracing methods.
name.quote: We introduce COVI-AgentSim, integrating detailed consideration of virology, disease progression, social contact networks, and behaviour/mobility patterns, based on parameters derived from empirical research.

name.justification: Digital Health Technology fits as a sub-field due to the focus on digital contact tracing applications and methods, like BCT and FCT, targeting COVID-19.
name.quote: Digital contact tracing (DCT), which uses smartphone apps to send messages between contacts with little to no delay, has been successfully deployed in some settings.

name.justification: COVI-AgentSim is the primary model proposed and validated in the paper for simulating and evaluating digital contact tracing methods.
name.quote: We introduce COVI-AgentSim, integrating detailed consideration of virology, disease progression, social contact networks, and behaviour/mobility patterns, based on parameters derived from empirical research.

is_contributed.justification: The paper contributes the COVI-AgentSim model as a novel tool specifically developed for the evaluation of digital contact tracing methods.
is_contributed.quote: We propose COVI-AgentSim - a software testbed to design, evaluate and benchmark DCT methods using cost-benefit analysis in terms of lives saved, reduction in effective reproductive number (Rt) of the virus, disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) averted, and productive hours lost.

is_executed.justification: The COVI-AgentSim model was executed to simulate COVID-19 spread and to evaluate the effectiveness of contact tracing methods under different scenarios.
is_executed.quote: We verify by comparing to real data that COVI-AgentSim is able to reproduce realistic COVID-19 spread dynamics, and perform a sensitivity analysis to verify that the relative performance of contact tracing methods are consistent across a range of settings.

is_compared.justification: COVI-AgentSim's results are compared against different configurations of contact tracing methods, and its output is validated against real-world data such as case and hospitalization data from Montreal.
is_compared.quote: We calibrate COVI-AgentSim to reproduce COVID-19 case and hospitalization data for the region of Montreal, Canada.
